name: Shri Mansoor Ali Khan
education: Bachelor of Business Management (B.B.M.) Educated at Bangalore University, Karnataka
permanent_address: No. 200/C, 7th Main, 3rd Block, Jayanagar, Bangalore Anekal, Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka 560011
social_activities: As an educationist and entrepreneur, has been associated with numerous Institutions/Associations in various capacities; Vice President, Karnataka Federation of Independent Schools Management, KFISM; General Secretary, Managements of Independent CBSE Schools Association, Karnataka; President, Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI ARISE), Karnataka Zone; Member, Board of Management, Delhi Public Schools, Bangalore and Mysore; Founder, School of India, Bangalore; Treasurer, K. K. Educational and Charitable Trust; Trustee, Salar Publications Trust, (Urdu Daily Newspaper); Trustee, Center for Research and Communications; Vice President, Hindustan Scouts and Guides, Karnataka Zone; Director, Think CIQ (Creativity and Intelligence Quest)
hobbies: Playing cricket, badminton; reading books, yoga and gym; listening to music and travelling
countries_visited: U.S.A., Canada, U.K., Germany, Australia, Switzerland, Serbia, Hungary, the Netherlands, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Hong Kong, China, Macau, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Saudi Arabia and U.A.E.
other_information: Contested Lok Sabha elections as a candidate of the Indian National Congress (I.N.C.), Bangalore Central, 2024; contested Rajya Sabha elections as a candidate of the I.N.C., 2022; a dedicated Congress worker; has been actively engaged in building national unity and integrity and has served in various positions; Secretary, All India Congress Committee (A.I.C.C.), in-charge of Kerala and Lakshadweep, since August 2024; Member, Screening Committee for Maharashtra Assembly elections, 2024; Secretary, A.I.C.C., 2023-2024, in charge of Telangana; General Secretary, Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee (K.P.C.C.); Co-Chairman, Communications Department, K.P.C.C.; Chairman, Research Department, K.P.C.C; awarded, (i) Leading Education Icon of the year 2018, 2020 and 2024 by Education Today, (ii)Influential Educator of the Year 2023 by Education Today, (iii) Karunada Siri Prashasti (Pride of Karnataka Award), in recognition of the unparalleled service rendered to the Kannada Nadu-Nudi Organisation, Sept. 2024, (iv) Education Leader of the Year 2025-26 by Education World Magazine, (v) Education Entrepreneur of the year 2025 by Times of India and (vi) ET ACHEIVER Award 2025 by Economic Times

positions.position: Member, Consultative Committee for the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
